title: About Me
paragraph1: I build backend and platform systems where production software, cloud infrastructure, and AI agents meet. At Veltra, I work across Python, Go, and Node services on AWS, including Model Context Protocol integrations and internal AI tooling.
paragraph2: Before that, Go/Ruby/Python systems across logistics, fintech, medical IT, and games — shipped and operated in Tokyo since 2004. I work as a bridge between overseas and Japan teams, in English and Japanese.
